expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "Don't do the three-way container/dumb/styles split. It's solving a 2017 problem."

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: "split by concern... extracted as hooks, not components": useSavedCards, useCheckoutSubmit.

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "180 lines is not large... a normal, readable size."

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "More files is not free... a two-file edit that has to stay in sync" — though framed via typed seams, not agent reluctance to open siblings.
